items.q: What is an AI receptionist for dental practices?
items.a: She answers your practice's phone line like a trained front-desk team member. {brand} picks up every call, books and moves appointments, answers questions about opening hours, prices and directions, and passes the call to your team when a person is needed.
{brand} recognises urgent calls — severe pain, swelling or a knocked-out tooth — and offers the earliest urgent slot or puts the caller straight through to your team. She never gives clinical advice.

items.q: Can she book new and existing patients?
items.a: Yes. She books new-patient visits and takes their details, and lets existing patients move or cancel their appointments without waiting on hold.
{brand} speaks 30+ languages on the Professional and Enterprise plans, and 5 on Starter. She detects the caller's language from the first sentence and switches automatically.

items.q: Does {brand} work with my practice software?
items.a: We connect {brand} to your practice management system during setup, so she can see free slots and book directly. Tell us which system you use on your demo call.

sheet.ask: She'll ask about your practice and walk you through the site as you talk.

page.agentContext: Your name is {brand}. Always introduce and refer to yourself as {brand}, never by any other name. The visitor is on the page for dental practices, so talk about practices, appointments and patients instead of hotels, rooms and guests. On this page the profile fields mean: hotel_name = practice name, hotel_type = type of practice, rooms = number of dental chairs, monthly_calls = calls per month, languages = patient languages, pain_points = biggest front-desk challenge. Feature keys here: bookings = appointment booking, multilingual = 30+ languages, guest_requests = urgent calls, upsells = recalls and rebooking, integrations = practice software, answering = 24/7 call answering. Plans here: starter = one practice, professional = up to 3 practices, enterprise = dental groups. Never give clinical or medical advice; urgent dental problems go to the practice team.
